text:
The "naive empiricist" label for Austin more plausibly refers to his account of law, which rests on an anachronistic model of a legal system—treating law as a straightforward command backed by sanction, as in Bentham and Austin's sovereign-command theory. On that reading the criticism is that Austin's jurisprudence builds on an outdated picture of legal order rather than a conceptually adequate analysis of law.

CONFIDENCE: 55
